[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Vin Emil''' was one of the original [[University of Sanbra]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] at the [[Q'Maere Research Facility]], and the station's [[xenobotanist]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] offered him a position at the facility when he converted it to a [[Prison/Legends|prison]], and Emil accepted. During his time at the facility, he created [[Variant Alpha]], an antidote to the strange bacteria mutation found in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]].
